title: Respawn Addicts
wikitext: == History == The last remaining Austrian QuakeWorld clan. The Clan was founded in September 2006. [http://xstretchmarks.com/how-to-get-rid-of-stretch-marks/ how to get rid of stretch marks] created the idea of making a Division 6 Quakeworld Clan to play in [[EQL]]. At that stage [[Defcon 5]] was playing with The Pimps but he decided to join the Austrian Clan to help beginners to get in touch with Quakeworld. [[Orion]] already played many duels with [[Defcon 5]] and so he didnt think long about joining the Clan too. Fortunatly [[watzl]] fell in Love with Quakeworld too so we got 4 horny Quakeworld Newbs :) We asked [[Slash]] if he want to play for [[Respawn Addicts]] too and he agreed after a long period of inactive time, he saw the beauty of raping enemies again. == Information == {{Clan-info | foundedyear = 2006 | foundedmonth = September | foundedday = | disbanded = | foundedby = [[Image:flag_at.gif]] [[Hoshi]] | nationality = Austrian | shortnationality = at | prefix = rEAd | color1 = 12 | color2 = 4 | ircchannel = read | ircnetwork = irc.se.quakenet.org | ircnetworkname = QuakeNet | website = http://read.quakeworld.at }} == Members == * [[Image:flag_at.gif]] [[Defcon 5]] * [[Image:flag_at.gif]] [[hoshi]] * [[Image:flag_at.gif]] [[kiu]] * [[Image:flag_at.gif]] [[orion (Austrian Player)|Orion]] * [[Image:flag_at.gif]] [[sLASh]] * [[Image:flag_at.gif]] [[watzl]] * [[Image:flag_ch.gif]] [[burps]] == Achievements == * [[2006]] - Not being last in [[EQL Season 4]] Division 5 (8th) * [[2007]] - 5th place: [[NQR Season 10]] Bronze Cup * [[2008]] - 2st place: [[EQL Season 6]] Division 5 == External links == * [http://www.challenge-tv.com/index.php?mode=demos&game=2&searchtext=read Demos with Respawn Addicts] * [http://read.quakeworld.at/ Respawn Addicts Homepage] [[Category:Clans]] [[Category:Austrian Clans]] __NOTOC__
